cases.question: Which dataset is this project using?
cases.answer: NASA C-MAPSS FD001, a subset of the 2008 Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set from the NASA Ames Prognostics
cases.evidence: FaultWatch uses NASA C-MAPSS FD001, a subset of the 2008 Turbofan Engine Degradation Simulation Data Set from the NASA Ames Prognostics Center of Excellence. FD001 simulates one operating condition (sea level) and one high-pressure compressor degradation mode. NASA publishes the dataset through its PCoE repository, dataset 6 and NASA Open Data catalog.

cases.question: How many consecutive readings does inference require?
cases.evidence: Inference requires 20 consecutive sensor readings for the same engine. The default model is the PyTorch MLP. It returns a nonnegative point estimate.

cases.question: After how much time do Redis entries expire?
cases.evidence: make cache enables the optional Redis service and the cache panel in Grafana. PostgreSQL supplies the current 20-cycle window on every prediction request. Redis keys include the model artifact checksum and the exact ordered readings. New telemetry gets a different key and older entries expire after two minutes. A hit skips feature extraction and inference. Redis errors fall back to direct scoring. Incomplete windows return insufficient history.
